parents_en: Son of Mateusz and Anna née Potsevna, Venck [?], lawfully married peasants, born on the 20th of July in the village of Kaerkshesi [?] of Salantai parish.
godparents_en: The godparents were the peasants Kazimierz [?] Lavkis and Katarzyna [?] Prikorov [?].
